commands.name: investigate
commands.description: Validate and persist source-grounded investigation state and emit a Change-bound handoff.

commands.name: changes
commands.description: List active changes, lifecycle status, and their next useful action.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Diagnose project, provider, and lifecycle readiness.

commands.name: packet
commands.description: Read the bounded machine handoff for the current operation.

commands.name: metrics
commands.description: Inspect measured usage, active budget, cost, and execution timing.

commands.name: advance
commands.description: Run deterministic lifecycle work through a requested target, including detected evidence wiring, safe sandbox sync, configured review, and task check completion, and return one bounded action at the next real model, user, resource, or authority boundary. --approve-spec records the user's spec approval (alias of change resolve --approve-spec); with --through it continues in the same call. --restore-target records the target files Land restores to the sandbox base when its apply conflicts; paths other than generated artifacts clean at isolation require --decision-ref. --recover-apply settles an interrupted Land apply under the user's decision, then continues.

commands.name: feedback
commands.description: Project repair-aware timing, guard provenance, evidence reuse, usage availability, and the next safe action without mutating state.

commands.name: exec
commands.description: Run and time an external command (build, container, tests), recording its duration for metrics.

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Describe both surfaces — the change-loop host commands and the CLI commands; every command also answers --help.

commands.name: change new
commands.description: Create a change agreement when atomic draft start does not apply.

commands.name: change start
commands.description: Inspect semantic intake or create and start an isolated change from one validated draft. The bare form inspects in place and starts only when intake is DONE; otherwise it prints the intake action and changes nothing. --approve-spec records the user's spec approval in the same call; with --through it continues.

commands.name: change resolve
commands.usage: change resolve <change> [--impact low|medium|high] [--coupling isolated|coupled] [--ambiguity clear|unclear] [--surface <glob,glob>] [--security <terms>] [--review] [--size xs|s|m|l] [--acceptance-not-required | --acceptance-required --acceptance-reason <why> [--acceptance-claims <ids>]] [--reopen-grounding --decision-ref <ref> --reopen-reason <why>] [--ci-not-required --decision-ref <ref>] [--approve-spec --decision-ref <ref>] [--continue-review --decision-ref <ref>] [--accept-target-edits --decision-ref <ref>]
commands.description: Persist agreement decisions or open one audited batched grounding revision.

commands.name: change amend
commands.description: Transactionally add, revise, or remove semantic requirements during Build, or correct an unfinished task's verify command, while preserving the canonical agreement. --task/--verify corrects one verify command directly and keeps the spec approval. The bare form inspects in place and amends only when intake is DONE; otherwise it prints the intake action and changes nothing. --approve-spec records the user's spec approval in the same call. --template prints an amendment template.

commands.name: change revise
commands.description: Recompile a revised semantic draft over a change that has not started Build, keeping its id and reporting the requirement delta for approval. The bare form inspects in place and revises only when intake is DONE; otherwise it prints the intake action and changes nothing. --approve-spec records the user's spec approval in the same call; with --through it continues.

commands.name: change validate
commands.description: Validate the change and executable evidence contract.

commands.name: change audit
commands.description: Audit scenario, claim, task, and provider traceability.

commands.name: sandbox create
commands.description: Create the isolated Build workspace.

commands.name: sandbox sync
commands.description: Synchronize an intentional contract revision into Build and reconcile a moved target: a worktree replays onto the new commit, an isolated copy fast-forwards the files it left alone.

commands.name: proof readiness
commands.description: Return typed blockers and canonical next commands.

commands.name: proof collect
commands.description: Collect executable evidence before an external boundary.

commands.name: proof advance
commands.description: Advance executable evidence, review, acceptance, and proof once; unchanged external waits resume without rerunning work.

commands.name: proof run
commands.description: Run readiness, providers, finalization, and audit atomically.

commands.name: land check
commands.description: Validate that the proven projection remains landable.

commands.name: land advance
commands.description: Advance the resumable Land saga and archive when every repository is ready.

commands.name: handoff status
commands.description: Show permission-bound external operations without treating them as developer tasks.

commands.name: handoff list
commands.description: List operational obligations across active and archived changes.

commands.name: handoff packet
commands.description: Emit the bounded DevOps/SRE operation packet, required evidence, rollback, and next command.

commands.name: handoff record
commands.description: Record a named operator's tracked acceptance, completion, rejection, cancellation, or supersession without storing credentials.

commands.name: land recover
commands.description: Settle an interrupted apply transaction after an explicit host-recorded user decision; manual recovery requires an explicit resolution.

commands.name: land archive
commands.description: Apply, synchronize, audit, archive, and clean up explicitly.

commands.name: deliver advance
commands.description: Optionally create an isolated commit and feature branch from an archived proven projection, open or reuse its pull request, and return the verified URL.

commands.name: agents plan
commands.description: Plan dispatch only for independently verifiable parallel work.

commands.name: agents dispatch
commands.description: Return the next graph- and lease-bound native-host Build action without invoking a model.

commands.name: evidence detect
commands.description: Detect safe project-owned provider candidates without executing them.

commands.name: evidence init
commands.description: Preview or explicitly write high-confidence provider wiring.

commands.name: evidence doctor
commands.description: Explain configured, detectable, and unresolved evidence wiring.

commands.name: evidence verify-ci
commands.description: Verify signed CI provenance bound to the provider workspace.

commands.name: hash
commands.description: Print the workspace hash a signed CI envelope must bind: the provider's receipt hash, or without a provider the change's workspace hash.

commands.name: authority request
commands.description: Create a resumable external review or acceptance request.

commands.name: authority status
commands.description: Inspect external authority; --template emits the response file to fill in.

commands.name: authority dispatch
commands.usage: authority dispatch <change> --request <id> --scope full|delta --reviewer-type ai|human --reviewer-identity <id> [--base-attempt <digest>] [AI provenance options]
commands.description: Reserve a policy-routed review attempt when work is handed to a reviewer.

commands.name: authority abort
commands.description: Close a review request; an already dispatched attempt remains consumed.

commands.name: authority run
commands.usage: authority run <change> --request <id> [--reviewer codex-sol] --subject-actor <id> [AI implementation provenance options]
commands.description: Run a configured read-only ephemeral reviewer, preserve its structured report, and record the bound response.

commands.name: authority reset-infra
commands.description: Acknowledge consumed reviewer infrastructure retries after the provider diagnosis passes, restoring AI review dispatch under an explicit host-recorded user decision.

commands.name: authority reset-base-move
commands.description: Release the one delivered passing AI review attempt a sandbox-sync base move expired from the wave budget, under an explicit host-recorded user decision, so the forced fresh review does not exhaust the cap.

commands.name: authority record
commands.description: Validate a bound host response and record its evidence.

commands.name: evidence record
commands.description: Record externally observed evidence requested by readiness.

commands.name: land record
commands.description: Bind a child repository commit after an explicit host-recorded user decision, only for a Land transaction the legacy commit-based saga already started; current changes use advance --through archived.

commands.name: land resume
commands.description: Resume an interrupted or multi-repository Land saga.

commands.name: budget checkpoint
commands.description: Show measured remaining allowance, unfinished work, the user decision boundary, and the exact resume route.

commands.name: budget continue
commands.description: Open one policy-gated completion window after an explicit host-recorded user decision.

commands.name: change abandon
commands.description: Retire a change that cannot be proven, quarantining its record after an explicit host-recorded user decision.

commands.name: change waive
commands.description: Withdraw one failing capability gate after an explicit host-recorded user decision; recorded in proof advisories and at Land, never a force-land. Review and acceptance keep their own routes.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Install or upgrade Foundation in a project; --host adds that host's adapter.

commands.name: providers
commands.description: Inspect evidence wiring only while defining a change contract.

commands.name: repos
commands.description: Inspect repository topology and selection.

commands.name: models
commands.description: Inspect model-tier policy.

commands.name: quality discover
commands.description: Detect repository languages, profiles, and quality capabilities without executing project commands.

commands.name: quality init
commands.description: Preview or explicitly write the committed consumer quality configuration.

commands.name: quality doctor
commands.description: Validate quality profiles, adapters, tools, isolation, and fallback readiness.

commands.name: quality run
commands.description: Run configured quality lanes and apply changed-code and affected-mutant ratchets.

commands.name: quality report
commands.description: Show the latest per-repository consumer quality result.

commands.name: quality baseline
commands.description: Preview or explicitly update versioned repository quality baselines.

commands.name: quality debt
commands.description: Render the latest non-silent quality debt inventory without widening change scope.

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Migrate corroborated legacy workflow records.

commands.name: version
commands.description: Print the installed package version.

commands.name: update check
commands.description: Inspect the cached latest stable release advisory without applying an update.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show canonical commands; --all includes compatibility routes.

commands.name: dashboard
commands.description: Manage the optional team-presence client.

commands.name: dashboard snapshot
commands.description: Inspect the versioned, read-only dashboard projection for this project.

commands.name: evidence upgrade
commands.description: Upgrade legacy evidence wiring explicitly.

commands.name: runtime
commands.description: Compatibility pass-through for installed workflow internals.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Compatibility alias for change validate.

commands.name: agents task
commands.description: Compatibility alias for packet --task.

commands.name: host agent-contract
commands.description: Return the package-owned Foundation agent contract through protocol 1 JSON without project discovery.

commands.name: host instruction
commands.description: Return one package-owned Foundation workflow instruction through protocol 1 JSON without project discovery.

commands.name: agents acquire
commands.description: Acquire a host-managed resource lease.

commands.name: agents release
commands.description: Release a host-managed resource lease; after takeover, --lease-id must identify the acquired generation. --force takes over another owner's lease, and one that has not expired also needs --decision-ref because a worker may still be running it.

commands.name: telemetry sync
commands.description: Synchronize native host request usage.

commands.name: telemetry import
commands.description: Import authoritative host usage.

commands.name: telemetry host-import
commands.description: Import a validated host execution result with attempts, actual model, fallback, and instruction provenance.

commands.name: sandbox challenge
commands.description: Create a short-lived challenge for signed unattended authority.

commands.name: evidence run
commands.description: Execute one low-level evidence adapter.

commands.name: sandbox inspect
commands.description: Inspect isolation diagnostics; with --unattended it also gates, failing when the security boundary is unsafe.

commands.name: sandbox apply
commands.description: Apply a proven projection through the Land journal.

commands.name: proof plan
commands.description: Compatibility alias for proof readiness.

commands.name: proof finish
commands.description: Compatibility alias for proof run.

commands.name: proof preflight
commands.description: Low-level proof topology check.

commands.name: proof execute
commands.description: Low-level provider execution and finalization.

commands.name: proof finalize
commands.description: Low-level finalization from valid receipts.

commands.name: proof audit
commands.description: Low-level proof artifact audit.

commands.name: land plan
commands.description: Persist the multi-repository Land saga plan.

commands.name: runtime hash
commands.description: Print the change's current relevant workspace hash.

commands.name: runtime event
commands.description: Record one host request event against the change's budget window.

commands.name: runtime api-version
commands.description: Print the installed runtime API version the CLI checks compatibility against.

commands.name: land pointers
commands.description: Stage proven submodule pointers.
